name: class_cat
description: The top broad category of the cluster. This is the class category used to color the map.

name: categories
description: Top categories for cluster. This will include the top 3, based on number of patent families in the category.

fields.name: NPF
fields.description: Number of patent families belonging to this category in the cluster.

name: tags
description: Tags for a cluster. These can be broad categories, categories, fields, subfields, or phrases.

name: top_3_country
description: Top 3 priority countries in a cluster.

name: NPF_all_years
description: Total number of patent families in the cluster.

name: NPF
description: Number of patent families in the cluster from the last 10 years.

name: cset_extracted_phrase
description: Keywords extracted from cluster.

name: cluster_title
description: Title of the cluster.

name: cluster_summary
description: Summary of the cluster.

name: categories_agg
description: String showing top categories for cluster. This will include the top 3, based on number of patent families in the category, as well as the count of their patent families.

name: ai_fields_agg
description: Top AI subfields for a cluster, formatted as a string, if patent is at least 1% AI-relevant. Subfields are included if they are in top 3 for cluster or 10% of patents in cluster belong to them.

name: biotech_fields_agg
description: Top biotech subfields for a cluster, formatted as a string, if patent is at least 1% biotech-relevant. Subfields are included if they are in top 3 for cluster or 10% of patents in cluster belong to them.

name: cybersecurity_fields_agg
description: Top cybersecurity subfields for a cluster, formatted as a string, if patent is at least 1% cybersecurity-relevant. Subfields are included if they are in top 3 for cluster or 10% of patents in cluster belong to them.

name: robotics_fields_agg
description: Top robotics subfields for a cluster, formatted as a string, if patent is at least 1% robotics-relevant. Subfields are included if they are in top 3 for cluster or 10% of patents in cluster belong to them.

name: ai_pred
description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered AI-relevant.

name: nlp_pred
description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered NLP-relevant.

name: cv_pred
description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered computer vision-relevant.

name: ro_pred
description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered robotics-relevant.

name: cyber_pred
description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered cybersecurity-relevant.

name: semiconductor_pred
description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered semiconductor-relevant.

name: biotech_pred
description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered biotech-relevant.

name: age
description: Mean cluster age.

name: mean_growth_3_year_p_rank
description: Cluster's growth percentile based on past 3 years.

name: cross_filing_percentile
description: Cluster's cross filing percentile. Based on what percentage of patents families in the cluster are filing in multiple jurisdictions.

name: industry_share
description: Industry share; includes organizations with no data in denominator.

name: education_share
description: Education share; includes organizations with no data in denominator.

name: nonprofit_share
description: Nonprofit share; includes organizations with no data in denominator.

name: government_share
description: Government share; includes organizations with no data in denominator.

name: grant_percentage
description: Percentage of patent families in the cluster that are grants; based on past ten years but excludes recent (past 3 years) patents, to avoid pending patents.

name: grant_percentile
description: Cluster's grant percentile. Grant percentage ranked over the full set of clusters.

name: n_pubs
description: The number of publications cited by patent families in the cluster.

name: frac_citing_pubs
description: The proportion of patent families in the cluster that cite at least one publication.

name: n_pubs_percentile
description: The percentile rank of the cluster based on the proportion of patent families in it that cite at least one publication, normalized by the cluster's class_cat.

name: cluster_id
description: Patent cluster ID.

name: x
description: Cluster x coordinate on chart.

name: y
description: Cluster y coordinate on chart.
